newsitem.title: CHINA: Gold closes lower in HK as U.S. trend continues.
newsitem.headline: Gold closes lower in HK as U.S. trend continues.

text.p: Hong Kong gold closed lower on Friday, with continued selling interest in Asia, extending its sharp declines in New York overnight, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$323.30/80 an ounce, down from New York's US$324.20/70 close on Thursday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$327.10/60.

"Gold continued its fall in the afternoon session as the U.S. dollar extended its rise," said a dealer at a local investment house. "But gold recovered and held at around US$323 levels where it found solid support."
Local gold ended HK$32 lower at HK$2,993 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange society rose to -0.50 from its previous fix at -3.00.
The local market will be closed on Monday.
